## Brand Strategy
- Titled "Brand Guidelines 2024" (file named 2021 but content says 2024)
- Tagline: "where your video lives"
- Positioning: competitive landscape, startup that's "not just starting" -- knows its stuff
- Guidelines cover logos, typefaces, color palettes, icons, patterns, and messaging
- Contact: Chelsea Grider, Senior Visual Designer, Switcher Studio
- Purpose: preserve visual identity, build recognition, protect logo assets, craft powerful messaging

## Logo
- Multiple logo configurations with different minimum sizes:
  - Primary: 0.75" print / 60px web minimum
  - Secondary (wider): 1" print / 100px web minimum
  - Icon/mark only: 0.25" print / 30px web minimum
- Clearspace measured using height of capital "S" in the logo
- Can be placed on primary/secondary palette colors, white, black, or gray backgrounds
- On imagery: must have sufficient contrast; white logotype preferred on dark backgrounds, color logotype on bright backgrounds

## Tone of Voice
- **Voice attributes:** Direct, Confident, Encouraging, Upbeat
- Direct: streamline messaging, remove complexity; "No BS, no fluff, no jargon"
- Confident: "laid-back conviction" -- believes in product and users without blustering
- Encouraging: "biggest cheerleaders" for users; "we win when our customers win"
- Upbeat: innovative, nimble, forward-thinking; "video should be fun, even when it's your business"
- **Brand personality:** Competent and Creative
  - Identity: Innovative
  - Language: Sincere, accessible
  - Motivation: Greatness, connection
  - Fear: Stagnation, disengagement
  - Characteristics: Genuine, imaginative, positive, open-minded

## Outliers
- Unusually detailed brand personality framework with motivation/fear archetypes -- more strategic depth than typical for a 27-page guide
- File name says 2021 but document content says 2024 -- likely updated
- Named contact person with email for asset requests -- rare to see individual contacts in guidelines
- Voice section is proportionally large relative to document length, suggesting brand voice is prioritized over visual system

## Quality Score
